# `Exposure`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Exposure progress from two producers: the legacy page/start/downloading/complete/fail sender and the function-state Exposure detail.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER (observation only) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ; all four producer shapes OBSERVED (2026-10-12) |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, SendExpEvent @0x214440 (64-bit build), PrintExpDuration @0x213ee0, ExpRetryTag @0x2165d0, ExpRetry sets the event flag @0x216d0c for sequence-list frames (64-bit build); ac_count writers RetrySolve @0x172500, AutoGotoFunc @0x1736d0 and @0x1747f8 (64-bit build), RetrySolve @0xf1568 and AutoGotoFunc @0xf1d28 (32-bit build); 32-bit build writes exp_ms and port too; all four shapes OBSERVED (2026-10-12) |

Two producers share the name; select the contract by members, not by name. (1) Legacy SendExpEvent (named single exposures, stack exposure cycle, sequence-list capture frames): sent only when the exposure parameter's event flag is set; always page, then tag if non-empty, then caller extension-map members; start adds exp_us and gain; downloading adds nothing; the terminal branch sends complete for code 0 or fail with error and code for a non-zero code. It never carries lapse_ms, exp_ms, port or route. (2) F detail named Exposure: Function-state family (F): SendFuncEvent formats the named function detail. state is always present; stage only when non-empty; lapse_ms while the timer runs or at a terminal state; error and code at fail (even when the stored code is zero; lookup failure gives 'fail to operate'); cancel omits code and error; route is optional function ancestry. The sender does no deduplication and needs no preceding working event. Detail flags can suppress the working or non-working sends while the cached function tree still changes, so a receiver can miss transitions. Its formatter adds exp_ms and port. Legacy microseconds and F milliseconds are separate serializer paths. The legacy extension map has exactly one member in both builds: ac_count (integer, the auto-goto attempt counter), on exposures taken by auto-goto and its solve retry; other legacy Exposure events carry no extension members. Cadence follows exposure and readout time; no fixed progress timer. Channels I (TCP 4700) and W (TCP 4702, forwarded onto 4700 by the main imager). Delivery: ordinary broadcast to every retained socket of the emitting server (master, guest and never-verified sockets alike); no cadence, delivery or ordering guarantee relative to RPC replies or other events. OBSERVED (2026-10-12, firmware not matched to 9.31, stored plan imaging): about one exposure cycle per 63 s gave a legacy start event, then near the end a burst of two legacy page/state events and two F events (route of length 2); a fail with code 514 was also seen. Legacy fail codes are 253 (client stop command such as stop_exposure, iscope_stop_view or stop_stack), 514 (interrupted by an internal stop; produced only by application workers, never by the camera layer, so not a camera or sensor fault) and 238 (retries exhausted) (READ). The APK also derives a local ExposureTag event from Exposure; that is not a wire event.

Side effects: Observation only for the receiver.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"Exposure"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string with nine fractional digits from a monotonic clock; not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `state` | string | yes | - | Union of two producers. F: idle, working, complete, fail, cancel. Legacy SendExpEvent: start, downloading, complete, fail. One of: `idle`, `working`, `complete`, `fail`, `cancel`, `start`, `downloading`. [READ] |
| `stage` | string | if stage string non-empty | - | Only when the detail holds a non-empty stage string; value set unresolved. [READ] |
| `lapse_ms` | integer | if timer started (working) or terminal state | - | Elapsed milliseconds (signed 32-bit low bits): current monotonic time minus start while working or started-but-unfinished, otherwise end minus start. Independent of Timestamp. F producer only. [READ] |
| `error` | string | if F: state is fail; legacy: terminal branch with non-zero code (state fail) | - | Message for code. [READ] |
| `code` | integer | if F: state is fail; legacy: terminal branch with non-zero code (state fail) | - | F: stored code at fail. Legacy: the non-zero supplied code. From the exposure retry path (READ): 253 when a client stop command (stop_exposure, iscope_stop_view, stop_stack, stop_create_dark and similar) aborted the frame (legacy fail, not an F cancel); 514 when the worker was stopped by any other, internal stop (for example a mode or page change or a superseding command; which ones occur live is INFERRED); the camera layer never produces 514, so it is not a camera or sensor fault and clients SHOULD NOT treat it as one; 238 when the capture retries ran out while the worker was still running. 514 also OBSERVED 2026-10-12. [READ] |
| `route` | array<string> | no | - | Function-ancestry names at send time (for example View, Stack); may be absent. Not an address. F producer only. [READ] |
| `exp_ms` | number | if F producer, exposure-control query succeeds | - | F producer: exposure duration in milliseconds, only when the exposure-control query succeeds. Serialized as a floating token. [READ] |
| `port` | integer | if F producer | - | F producer: the JSON event-server port of the emitting process, not an image stream port. [READ] |
| `page` | string | if legacy producer (always) | - | Legacy producer: current device page name. [READ] |
| `tag` | string | if legacy producer, tag non-empty | - | Legacy producer: exposure parameter tag, only when non-empty. [READ] |
| `exp_us` | integer | if legacy state start | - | Legacy start: exposure time in microseconds. [READ] |
| `gain` | integer | if legacy state start | - | Legacy start: camera gain; control scale unresolved. [READ] |
| `ac_count` | integer | if legacy producer, exposure taken by auto-goto or its solve retry | - | Legacy producer: auto-goto attempt counter, the only extension-map member in either build. Only on exposures taken by auto-goto and its solve retry. [READ] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, legacy-start - Legacy start (shape OBSERVED 2026-10-12; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"Exposure","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","page":"stack","state":"start","exp_us":10000000,"gain":80}
```

Event, legacy-downloading - Legacy phase (shape OBSERVED 2026-10-12; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"Exposure","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","page":"stack","state":"downloading"}
```

Event, legacy-fail - Legacy failure (shape OBSERVED 2026-10-12 with code 514; text invented):

```json
{"Event":"Exposure","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","page":"stack","state":"fail","error":"example error","code":514}
```

Event, function-complete - F producer (shape OBSERVED 2026-10-12; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"Exposure","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"complete","lapse_ms":10512,"exp_ms":10000.0,"port":4700,"route":["View","Stack"]}
```
